programmes.name: Amazon Associates UK
programmes.disclosure_text: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
notes: Approved 15 Nov 2026 with full acceptance (#11, S1-8b). This reflects Kieran's reading of Associates Central; no screenshot or account data is stored here.

The tracking id is never stored in the repo: it is read only from AMAZON_ASSOCIATES_UK_TAG at build time. Links are built only when SITE_ENV=production and the build is not a Cloudflare preview (enforced in code: isProductionLinkBuild); preview builds also leave the tag unset.
A link renders only for verified, exact-match products (verification: 'verified' with verification_evidence), with the tag set and well formed.
No API access: Amazon prices, availability and delivery are not displayed.
